html:
G'oya

Har bir smena alohida ustun, demak har ustunda o'zining SUM(CASE ...) i: qator shu smenaga tushsa, nonlari qo'shiladi, aks holda 0. Butun qiyinchilik tungi smenada: u yarim tundan o'tadi va bitta oraliq bilan yozilmaydi.

Yechim

SELECT baker,
       SUM(CASE WHEN hour BETWEEN 6 AND 13 THEN loaves ELSE 0 END) AS morning,
       SUM(CASE WHEN hour BETWEEN 14 AND 21 THEN loaves ELSE 0 END) AS evening,
       SUM(CASE WHEN hour >= 22 OR hour <= 5 THEN loaves ELSE 0 END) AS night
FROM batches
GROUP BY baker

Tungi smena ikki bo'lakdan iborat: kun oxiri (22, 23) va kun boshi (0 dan 5 gacha). Ular OR bilan birlashadi. Namunada Rustamning tungi nonlari 23 dagi 150 va 2 dagi 90, jami 240.

Tuzoqlar

BETWEEN 22 AND 5 yozish. BETWEEN a AND b bu hour >= a AND hour <= b, va 22 dan katta, 5 dan kichik son yo'q. Shart hech qachon rost bo'lmaydi va tungi ustun hammada 0:

Noto'g'riSELECT baker,
       SUM(CASE WHEN hour BETWEEN 6 AND 13 THEN loaves ELSE 0 END) AS morning,
       SUM(CASE WHEN hour BETWEEN 14 AND 21 THEN loaves ELSE 0 END) AS evening,
       SUM(CASE WHEN hour BETWEEN 22 AND 5 THEN loaves ELSE 0 END) AS night
FROM batches
GROUP BY baker

Tungini faqat hour >= 22 deb olish yarmini yo'qotadi: Anvarning soat 5 dagi 70 ta va 0 dagi 40 ta noni hech qaysi ustunga tushmaydi.

ELSE 0 yozilmasa, smenada ishlamagan novvoyda SUM faqat NULL larni ko'radi va 0 o'rniga NULL qaytaradi.

Boshqa yo'l

Tungi smena "tonggi ham, kechki ham emas", ya'ni hour NOT BETWEEN 6 AND 21. Bu yozuvda chegaralarni bir marta o'ylash yetadi.
